summary: Databag is a federated and end-to-end encrypted messaging service available on the web and mobile platforms. It facilitates text, photo, and video sharing, alongside WebRTC-based audio and video calls, operating outside of centralised provider infrastructure.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a decentralised and encrypted communication channel across multiple devices without relying on third-party servers.
watchOut: The development activity is low, meaning you might encounter unresolved bugs or lack timely security patches for newly discovered vulnerabilities.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
